intro: We built Upmods Eudora to hold what your wardrobe can’t. Eudora’s deep underbed storage and wide headboard make it easier to rest well — and organising — beautifully simple.

features.title: Built for strength, styled for your life
features.text: Made with premium engineered wood, our bed delivers dependable support wrapped in clean, elegant design — made to be lived in and loved.

features.title: Headboard that blends comfort and presence
features.text: The wide, rectangular headboard gives your room a modern focal point, while offering cosy support whenever you lean back and unwind.

features.title: Hydraulic storage that lifts your lifestyle
features.text: With our smooth lift-up base, you can access generous underbed storage effortlessly — no bending, no heavy lifting, just practical ease at your fingertips. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Earthy tones that calm your space
features.text: Our rich cinnamon finish adds warmth and natural charm to your bedroom — helping you create a space that feels both grounded and inviting.

features.title: Durable finish, minimal fuss
features.text: Protected with a PU coating, your bed stays looking polished for years to come — resisting everyday scratches and keeping its finish flawless.

name: Upmods Eudora King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
